editorial:
Imagine jumping back in time to the era of silent films where a single funny face could tell a whole story. You get to meet Alice Howell, who brings a wild and chaotic energy to this short comedy. The whole vibe is lighthearted and silly, focusing on the kind of physical humor that makes you laugh out loud without needing a single word of dialogue. It feels like a playful sketch that doesn't take itself too seriously, making it a great pick if you just want to switch off your brain and enjoy some old-school slapstick fun.

What really hits home is how Alice Howell handles the comedy timing. Her expressions are gold, and the pacing keeps things moving quickly so you never get bored. While the quality is obviously aged, the charm is timeless. If you are a fan of movie history or just love goofy characters, you should definitely check this out.
